hints.title: Generating Symmetrical Candidates
hints.text: Constructing numbers that are already palindromic in base 10 eliminates the need to inspect non-palindromic values.

hints.title: Base Transformation
hints.text: Convert each generated base-10 palindrome into base k and verify if its string representation equals its reverse.

hints.title: Systematic Prefix Expansion
hints.text: Iterate over increasing half lengths to produce both odd-length and even-length palindromes in strictly increasing magnitude.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: n: number of k-mirror numbers required
complexity.notes: Base-10 palindromes are enumerated by half-length prefixes and converted to base k for symmetric checking.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing every integer sequentially exceeds the execution time limit because palindromes become sparse.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Generating numbers palindromic in base 10 directly avoids testing non-palindromes.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should enumerate base-10 palindromes and test base-k symmetry.
